preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.
The size of arrays A and B is between 1 and 10^5.
The elements of arrays A and B are within the range of -10^14 to 10^14.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is -1 or an integer between 0 and N
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is impossible to convert A into B, otherwise it is the minimum number of operations required.

invariants.expression: For all i, A_i + k <= B_i for some k >= 0
invariants.description: For each element in A, there must be a corresponding increment in B that is at least as large.

invariants.expression: If A_i > B_i, then A_{i+1} + 1 <= B_{i+1}
invariants.description: If an element in A exceeds its counterpart in B, the next element in A must be incremented to allow for the difference.

invariants.expression: If A_i < B_i, then A_{i+1} >= B_{i+1}
invariants.description: If an element in A is less than its counterpart in B, the next element in A must be at least as large to allow for future increments.
